subparts.author_derivation: Original x=1/(2t+1)², y=sqrt(t+2). For finite derivative t>−2,t≠−1/2: dx/dt=−4/(2t+1)³,dy/dt=1/(2sqrt(t+2)), hence dy/dx=−(2t+1)³/(8sqrt(t+2)). Gradient−1 implies (2p+1)³=8sqrt(p+2)>0, so p>−1/2. Take REAL cube root to obtain2p+1=2(p+2)^(1/6), and divide2. Genuine parametric geometry, not an explicit-function item.
